name: asa
description: A woman in her thirties, a farmer. A plain, sturdy, warm voice, practical and down to earth.
reference_text: Good black soil, under all this moss. Who left it to go wild like this? A shame, that's what it is. Give me a spade and one dry summer, and I'll have barley standing taller than you. Don't laugh! I've done it before, and I'll do it again.
